answer: Creating a sybil identity means acquiring and locking fresh copper, jade, or opal at market price plus a slashing haircut, so N fake identities cost N times the bond. Require each agent to bond a scarce resource token: miners stake copper, artisans stake jade, couriers stake opal, and reputation accrues only against these locked assets. Since bonds are slashed on verified fraud and unlock slowly, attacks scale linearly in real capital, making mass identity spoofing economically irrational. From sa0039's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
